Swiss Keepsakes / Throwaway design study

A better first impression.

Four banner compositions, built with the app's real photos and current theme. The approved bridge-and-tower logo is shown in every header.

01 Immersive Lucerne

Kapellbrücke, Lucerne

The destination leads. A full-bleed real photo, cinematic crop and large white type. Most atmospheric. The white button keeps the scene quiet.

02 The local edit

47°03′ N · 8°18′ E

The clearest shopping welcome. A crisp scenic window with an overlapping editorial panel. Close to the app's current cards and restrained typography.

03 Lakeside morning

The lightest, freshest direction. The approved sky and cream colours, an oversized greeting and a curved lake photo. A red action brings it back to the app.

04 Made to remember

The most gift-focused direction. An asymmetric collage of the place, product and craft. More expressive, with actual catalogue photography.

The approved Swiss Keepsakes logo.

The original bridge, tower and lake ripples. Swiss red symbol, ink wordmark, transparent background.

Approved bridge-and-tower logo

Applied to the home header, compact header and browser icon in the project.

Standalone brand mark

Throwaway HTML study. Real app photos embedded. Google Fonts loads the app's typefaces; system fallbacks work offline. Actions are demonstration links, not a live shop. Approved logo assets are embedded with transparent backgrounds.
